summary.title: FABRIKKGATA 4 AS

narrative.text: FABRIKKGATA 4 AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom", registered 2016-05-11.
Registered activity: Eie og drift av fast eiendom. Samt konsulenttjenester av ulik art.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 565,000 and an annual result of NOK 430,292.
Registered leadership: Leif Anders Skipenes (Styrets leder).
Head office in Sandefjord, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
